title: Room 4D Project 001 — Question
description: Schema for a single exam-style question in the Project 001 (Insurance License Exam) question bank. This is a data-shape contract, not stored question data — imported/authored questions should validate against it. Source-provided answers and human-verified answers are tracked as two distinct fields on purpose: never treat an imported PDF's marked answer as authoritative without a verification step.

questionId.description: Permanent, stable question ID. Never reused or renumbered. Suggested format: Q-<sourceId>-<sequence>, e.g. Q-S001-0007.

knowledgePointIds.description: One or more knowledge-point IDs (from knowledge-points.json) this question assesses. A question may test more than one point.

domainId.description: Primary domain ID (from domains.json) this question belongs to. Should match the domainId of its knowledgePointIds.

questionText.description: The question stem, in its primary language.

choices.description: Answer choices. For multiple choice this is typically 4 entries; other question types may use fewer/more.

sourceAnswer.description: The answer as marked/selected in the original source material (e.g. a PDF's printed answer key or a human's circled choice). NOT assumed correct — see verifiedAnswer. Null if the source provided no marked answer.

verifiedAnswer.description: The answer confirmed correct through human or authoritative review. Null until verification has actually happened — do not copy sourceAnswer here automatically. This is the field the platform should trust for scoring once verificationStatus reflects that.

answerExplanation.description: Explanation of why the verified answer is correct.

wrongAnswerExplanations.description: Map of choice key -> explanation of why that specific wrong choice is incorrect (supports diagnosing the exact misconception behind a wrong answer).

language.description: Primary language of questionText/choices. BCP-47 style, e.g. 'en', 'zh'.

sourceId.description: ID of the source document this question was imported from (from source-registry.json), e.g. 'S001'. Null for originally-authored questions with no source PDF.

sourcePage.description: Page number (or range/label) within the source document.

sourceQuestionNumber.description: The question's original number/label within its source document, for traceability back to the PDF.

sourceNotes.description: Free-text notes about the source context of this question (e.g. formatting quirks, ambiguity in the scan, OCR issues).

humanAnnotations.description: Human markings found on the source material for this question — stars, underlines, highlighted words, selected answers, margin notes — preserved rather than discarded, since they may later become AI teaching/coaching assets.

memoryAids.description: Mnemonic devices or memory aids associated with this question or its knowledge point(s), captured from source material or added later.

bilingualNotes.description: Paired-language notes (e.g. a Chinese explanation of an English term) found in or derived from the source material.

verificationStatus.description: How trustworthy this question's verifiedAnswer/content currently is.

regulatorySensitivity.description: True if this question touches regulatory, tax, or legal content that changes over time (e.g. contribution limits, licensing rules, tax code references) and therefore needs periodic re-verification even after being marked verified.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this question record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this question record was last modified.

content.description: The annotated text or a description of the mark.

sourceLocation.description: Where on the page/document this annotation appears.

term.description: Added in D-001B: the specific vocabulary term or phrase this note is glossing, when narrower than the full 'primary' text.

note.description: Added in D-001B: free-text elaboration on the distinction/nuance being taught (e.g. contrasting two similar terms), separate from the literal translation.
